target_claim: Determine whether the K427 smooth cokernel survives as reduced Hilbert cohomology and whether the same transverse multiplier admits a bounded Green inverse.
scope: Multiplication by 1-t on L2([0,1]) and the associated 70-by-91 diagonal control family; no positive physical K77 domain is selected.

gu_typed_objects.carrier: L2([0,1])^91 -> L2([0,1])^70; LAYER=conditional Hilbert completion; CHIRALITY=N/A
gu_typed_objects.action_owner: none; the multiplier is the K425/K427 control completion
gu_typed_objects.target: closed range, reduced cokernel and bounded Green inverse MAP-TYPE=bounded-multiplier

preflight_bookend.route_comparison: Test closed range and reduced cohomology directly before treating the smooth evaluation class as a Green-compatible functional target.
preflight_bookend.retrieval_collision_result: K424 leaves the Green/domain question open and K427 computes only the smooth quotient.
preflight_bookend.strongest_alternative: A weighted Sobolev or boundary-trace domain may recover a closed finite cokernel, but no action-owned choice is serialized.

hilbert_result.proper_range_witness: the constant function 1 has formal preimage 1/(1-t), which is not in L2

decision.next_exact_input: An action-owned closed domain or boundary condition whose range, Green operator and physical pairing are proved on the actual variable differential.

postflight_bookend.strongest_overclaim: Calling zero reduced cokernel proof that every functional or boundary completion is exact.
postflight_bookend.strongest_contrary_construction: A trace-sensitive Sobolev domain or a different weight can make evaluation continuous and produce a closed cokernel.
postflight_bookend.weakest_reproducibility_seam: The L2 multiplier theorem and witness sequence are exact; the L2 choice and coefficient are not source/action selected.

claim_ceiling: Exact L2 closed-range boundary for the control coefficient 1-t. The multiplier is injective with dense proper nonclosed range; normalized inputs supported near t=1 have output norm 1/(sqrt(3)n), so no bounded Green inverse exists. The unreduced cokernel is nonzero and non-Hausdorff, while the reduced Hilbert cokernel is zero. Thus K427's smooth class is not category-independent. This constructs no action-owned domain, positive physical pairing, observation map or physical BV/BFV cohomology and moves no source, ledger, canon, paper, public, novelty or GU verdict.
